author: Mark Atwood
text: Deferring out of the JMAP-ayoz review-loop frontier. This is a workspace-wide canonical-template change touching 6+ crates (canonical jmap-mail-server first, then propagate to chat / calendars / tasks / contacts / sharing / metadata servers). It needs its own epic with per-crate children rather than being worked inline inside a single-crate review loop. Will queue for a dedicated session.
